audit.whatIsWrong: STALE MECHANIC, five instances. whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1] all say Pantheon's PASSIVE blocks or 'eats' your first W-empowered auto. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will — 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered'. It blocks nothing. The blocking is Aegis Assault (E), an active 22s-at-rank-1 channel that makes him invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/pantheon.json — P Mortal Will; E Aegis Assault cd 22/21/20/19/18, flags shield + untargetable + channel ('interruptible — any CC cancels it'). The page's version tells the player their empowered auto is auto-denied and there is nothing to do about it. The truth is the opposite and it is actionable twice over: it costs him a 22-second cooldown, it only covers his front, and Body Slam's stun cancels the channel outright.
audit.corrected: Name Mortal Will as the empowerment, Aegis Assault as the frontal block, and state that the Body Slam stun interrupts the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradict the packet levelChart and their own why-text: Level 1 is 'Skill' while whys[0] calls him a top-tier level-1 bully; Level 2 is Pantheon while whys[1] says 'roughly even'; Level 6 is 'Skill' while whys[4] calls it a genuine all-in he can't escape; first item and 2+ items are Pantheon while whys[5] calls Riftmaker 'your spike' and whys[6] says extended fights go to you. Both layers carry all five.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Pantheon / Skill / Pantheon / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas. Mechanically: Shield Vault is a 13s rank-1 point-click stun into a Mortal Will spear against a Gragas with one spell; from level 6 a 100s Explosive Cask plus the stun beats a champion whose only ultimate is a 180s global roam, and his spear damage does not scale with the fight length that Happy Hour does.
audit.corrected: win[0] to Pantheon, win[1] to Skill, win[4]/win[5]/win[6] to Gragas; phases[0].side to Pantheon, phases[1].side to Skill, phases[4]/[5]/[6].side to Gragas, with ratings and why-text moved with them.

notes: The 'Aegis passive' the page describes five times has not existed since Pantheon's rework — his passive is Mortal Will and the block is the active Aegis Assault. That mattered enough to correct everywhere because the page framed it as an unavoidable tax on your empowered auto rather than a 22-second cooldown with an open back and an interruptible channel. dontsFull[1].t still reads 'Sit low for his W execute' — Shield Vault has no execute component in the kit, but the title is 25 characters and sits at the applier's skip threshold, so I fixed the body underneath it instead and am flagging the title here. mirrorFindings cites '14s' for Aegis Assault; the kit says 22/21/20/19/18 and 14s is the Gragas Body Slam figure, so I used the kit.
